input: What controversies did the decision of FIFA to host the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar spark?
target: The decision of FIFA to host the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar sparked a number of concerns and controversies regarding both Qatar's suitability as a host country and the fairness of the FIFA World Cup bidding process.

input: What human rights criticisms focused on Qatar in relation to the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
target: Criticism of human rights in Qatar focused on the treatment of migrant workers, women, and position on LGBT rights, leading to allegations of sportswashing.

input: What actions and statements occurred around boycotts and Sepp Blatter regarding the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar?
target: Boycotts of the event were declared by several countries, clubs, and individual players, while former FIFA President Sepp Blatter has twice said that giving Qatar hosting rights was a "mistake".

input: What scrutiny arose concerning match attendance figures at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar?
target: Match attendance figures have also come under scrutiny as reported crowd attendances have exceeded stadium capacities despite games having visible empty seats.

input: What did a survey among 1,000 low-wage workers find about Qatar's labour reforms before the 2022 World Cup?
target: A survey among 1,000 low-wage workers found that 86% of respondents felt that the labour reforms had positively affected their lives.

input: What change regarding worker rights and employer incentives was reported in Qatar before the 2022 World Cup?
target: Now workers can negotiate for better conditions, and employers are incentivised to provide them in order to attract and retain talent.

input: What impact did change to the kafala system reportedly have in Qatar prior to the 2022 World Cup?
target: Change to the kafala system has led to labour mobility.

input: What did Sharan Burrow of the International Trade Union Confederation say on October 17, 2019 about Qatar's kafala reform?
target: “Qatar is changing. The new kafala system tranche of law will bring an end to kafala and put in place a modern industrial relations system” said Sharan Burrow, General Secretary of the International Trade Union Confederation.

input: What is the legal status of LGBTQ rights and homosexuality in Qatar by Islamic sharia law in the run-up to the 2022 World Cup?
target: Due to Islamic sharia law, there are no LGBTQ rights in Qatar, with homosexuality, as well as campaigning for LGBTQ rights, criminalised.

input: What did FIFA tell European teams about wearing rainbow-coloured armbands on the day of the first match involving one of those teams in the 2022 World Cup?
target: Typically, kit violations incur a fine, which the teams had said they would pay; on the day of the first match involving one of the European teams, FIFA told the teams that they would receive a yellow card as a minimum.
